markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set and 5/5 Normal neighbors support it [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 100%; others <1% | Strongly favors Normal |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 99%; OOD 26th percentile | Typical input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Concurs |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal | Neighbors all match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 1, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; largest concept term; spot check 0/20. · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; points away from invasive. · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Scarce tubules; concept model links this to invasive. · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion-test CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect classifier use. Leans on Normal lobules, which is Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated stain degradation (severity 3); reliability score ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69).
- Conformal coverage is 92% on only 132 test cases (CI 81–98%); guarantee is dataset-level.

## Check on the slide
1. **0, 1, 9**: Confirm two-layered lobular epithelium yourself; concept spot check failed (0/20).
2. **6**: Strongest tubule signal yet still low; confirm gland formation is genuinely sparse.
3. **4, 5**: Highest infiltrating-stroma scores (concept 19/20 validated); confirm stroma is benign.
